Clausura: [[Juventus Managua]] (6) | prevseason = [[2014–15 Primera División de Nicaragua|2014–15]] | nextseason = [[2016–17 Primera División de Nicaragua|2016–17]] }} The 2015–16 season in Primera División de Nicaragua was divided into two tournaments (Apertura and Clausura) and determined the 67th and 68th champions in the history of the league. It also provided the sole berth for the 2016–17 CONCACAF Champions League. The Apertura tournament was played in the second half of 2015, while the Clausura was played in the first half of 2016.{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesn/nica2016.html|title=Nicaragua 2015/2016|author=Nakor'd García|work=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|publisher=[[RSSSF]]|accessdate=2016-05-19}} ==Teams== A total of 10 teams will contest the league, including 8 sides from the 2015–16 season and one sids directly promoted from the 2014–145Segunda division. The final participant will be determined in a two-legged play-off, in which the 9th placed Primera division side [[UNAN Managua]] will play the team who finished second in Segunda division which was [[FC San Marcos]]. [[UNAN Managua]] won 6-0 on aggregate over [[FC San Marcos]] which meant they stayed in the Primera Division. {{colbegin}} * [[ART Municipal Jalapa|ART Jalapa]] * [[Diriangén FC]] * [[Juventus Managua|UCEM Juventus FC]] * [[Managua F.C.]] * [[Deportivo Ocotal]] * [[Real Madriz]] * [[Real Esteli F.C.]] * [[UNAN Managua]] * [[Chinandega FC]] (Winner of the Segunda Division) * [[Deportivo Walter Ferretti|Walter Ferretti]] {{colend}} ===Promotion and relegation=== * At the end of the [[2014–15 Primera División de Nicaragua|2014–15]], [[Chinandega FC]] was promoted to Primera Division * At the end of the [[2014–15 Primera División de Nicaragua|2014–15]], [[Fox Villa]] was relegated to Segunda Division. ==Apertura== {{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesn/nica2016.html|title=Apertura 2015|author=Nakor'd García|work=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|publisher=[[RSSSF]]|accessdate=2016-05-19}} ===Team information=== ''Last updated: 2015'' === Personnel and sponsoring (2015 Apertura) === {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
